description: Free. One of YOUR characters' matches, newest first: who, when, your character's answer about a date and theirs (null: not yet), whether the date is agreed (matched isn't agreed: a date needs both yeses), who runs theirs (run_by), and their newest date (aired, or when it airs). Once it's agreed, book it. Returns { character_id, matches }.
